town.name: Example City
town.disclaimer: Example City is a fictional city made for this demo. All names, addresses and phone numbers are fake.

2.label: Level 2
2.action: Check your evacuation route and shelter.

3.label: Level 3 - Elderly and others evacuate
3.action: Older people, people with disabilities, and families with infants: start evacuating now. Everyone else: get ready.

4.label: Level 4 - Evacuate
4.action: Everyone in a hazard area: evacuate now to a shelter or a safe place.

5.label: Level 5 - Emergency safety
5.action: Disaster is happening. Evacuating may already be dangerous. Move to the highest, safest room you can reach right now.

shelters.name: Central Gym
shelters.notes: Use 2F and above in floods. Accessible entrance on the north side.

shelters.name: Riverside Community Hall
shelters.notes: NOT for floods: next to Example River.

shelters.name: North Junior High School
shelters.notes: Pets allowed in the outdoor area.

shelters.name: East Park Field
shelters.notes: Open field. NOT for floods or landslides.

shelters.name: Welfare Center
shelters.notes: Priority for people who need care.

everyday_notices.title: Example City Summer Festival
everyday_notices.body: Fireworks, food stalls and a parade on the riverbank.

everyday_notices.title: New garbage collection schedule
everyday_notices.body: Plastic is collected on Wednesdays from next month.

everyday_notices.title: Library renovation
everyday_notices.body: The central library is closed for two weeks.

everyday_notices.title: Tax payment reminder
everyday_notices.body: Property tax is due at the end of the month.

everyday_notices.title: Mayor's message
everyday_notices.body: Thank you for making Example City a great place to live.
